description: Boolean status indicator stored as string with inconsistent textual representations for true/false states. Contains 30 non-null records with 6 distinct categorical values representing two logical states: affirmative ('True', '1', 'yes') and negative ('False', '0', 'no'). No missing values detected. Column is technically stored as string but intended to be boolean.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert all affirmative representations to boolean True: 'True' → True, '1' → True, 'yes' → True. Convert all negative representations to boolean False: 'False' → False, '0' → False, 'no' → False.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to boolean format (True/False) after standardization.
